# Transitions

46 transitions between primary-track clips. Set one on the *incoming* clip:

```json
{ "id": "c2", "assetId": "b", "transition": { "type": "slideleft", "duration": 0.4 } }
```

The transition overlaps the two clips by its duration, which shortens the timeline by that amount. Durations are clamped to fit short clips. All transitions are rendered with FFmpeg `xfade`, and audio crossfades at the same time.

| id | Name | Category | Default duration | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fade` | Crossfade | basic | 0.5s | Smooth dissolve between clips. Safe default for any content. |
| `fadeblack` | Dip to Black | basic | 0.8s | Fade out to black then into the next clip. Signals a scene/time change. |
| `fadewhite` | Dip to White | basic | 0.6s | Flash to white between clips. Dreamy or energetic. |
| `dissolve` | Dissolve | basic | 0.6s | Grainy pixel dissolve. |
| `fadegrays` | Fade Through Gray | basic | 0.7s | Desaturate while crossfading. |
| `wipeleft` | Wipe Left | wipe | 0.5s | Hard-edge wipe moving left. |
| `wiperight` | Wipe Right | wipe | 0.5s | Hard-edge wipe moving right. |
| `wipeup` | Wipe Up | wipe | 0.5s | Hard-edge wipe moving up. |
| `wipedown` | Wipe Down | wipe | 0.5s | Hard-edge wipe moving down. |
| `smoothleft` | Smooth Wipe Left | wipe | 0.6s | Soft-edge wipe to the left. |
| `smoothright` | Smooth Wipe Right | wipe | 0.6s | Soft-edge wipe to the right. |
| `smoothup` | Smooth Wipe Up | wipe | 0.6s | Soft-edge wipe upward. |
| `smoothdown` | Smooth Wipe Down | wipe | 0.6s | Soft-edge wipe downward. |
| `diagtl` | Diagonal Wipe | wipe | 0.6s | Diagonal wipe from the top-left corner. |
| `slideleft` | Slide Left | slide | 0.4s | Next clip pushes in from the right. Great for lists and sequences. |
| `slideright` | Slide Right | slide | 0.4s | Next clip pushes in from the left. |
| `slideup` | Slide Up | slide | 0.4s | Next clip pushes in from the bottom. Feels like scrolling a feed. |
| `slidedown` | Slide Down | slide | 0.4s | Next clip pushes in from the top. |
| `coverleft` | Cover Left | slide | 0.4s | Next clip slides over the current one from the right. |
| `coverright` | Cover Right | slide | 0.4s | Next clip slides over the current one from the left. |
| `revealleft` | Reveal Left | slide | 0.4s | Current clip slides away to the left revealing the next. |
| `revealright` | Reveal Right | slide | 0.4s | Current clip slides away to the right revealing the next. |
| `squeezeh` | Squeeze Horizontal | slide | 0.5s | Squeeze horizontally into the next clip. |
| `squeezev` | Squeeze Vertical | slide | 0.5s | Squeeze vertically into the next clip. |
| `circleopen` | Iris Open | shape | 0.6s | Circle opens from the center revealing the next clip. |
| `circleclose` | Iris Close | shape | 0.6s | Circle closes toward the center. |
| `circlecrop` | Circle Crop | shape | 0.7s | Circular crop through black. |
| `rectcrop` | Rectangle Crop | shape | 0.7s | Rectangular crop through black. |
| `radial` | Clock Wipe | shape | 0.6s | Radial clock-hand sweep. |
| `horzopen` | Barn Door Open (H) | shape | 0.5s | Opens horizontally from the center. |
| `vertopen` | Barn Door Open (V) | shape | 0.5s | Opens vertically from the center. |
| `horzclose` | Barn Door Close (H) | shape | 0.5s | Closes horizontally toward the center. |
| `vertclose` | Barn Door Close (V) | shape | 0.5s | Closes vertically toward the center. |
| `pixelize` | Pixelize | stylized | 0.6s | Pixelate out and back in. Retro / gaming feel. |
| `hblur` | Motion Blur | stylized | 0.4s | Horizontal blur whip between clips. |
| `zoomin` | Zoom In | stylized | 0.5s | Zoom into the current clip while fading to the next. Energetic. |
| `distance` | Distance | stylized | 0.6s | Distorted morph between clips. |
| `hlslice` | Slice Left | stylized | 0.5s | Sliced horizontal wipe. |
| `hrslice` | Slice Right | stylized | 0.5s | Sliced horizontal wipe the other way. |
| `vuslice` | Slice Up | stylized | 0.5s | Sliced vertical wipe upward. |
| `vdslice` | Slice Down | stylized | 0.5s | Sliced vertical wipe downward. |
| `hlwind` | Wind Left | stylized | 0.6s | Wind-swept streaks to the left. |
| `hrwind` | Wind Right | stylized | 0.6s | Wind-swept streaks to the right. |
| `squeeze` | Squeeze | stylized | 0.5s | Alias of squeezev. (xfade `squeezev`) |
| `whip` | Whip Pan | stylized | 0.25s | Fast blurred whip pan. Alias of hblur with a short duration. (xfade `hblur`) |
| `glitch` | Glitch Cut | stylized | 0.25s | Short pixelize burst — reads as a digital glitch. (xfade `pixelize`) |
